everyone.title: Calls transfer and end by the agent
everyone.text: The agent hands a caller to a colleague on the route's list and ends the call after its goodbye. It can follow the caller's language from the first words.

everyone.title: Pictures and files from tools
everyone.text: A tool's pictures and files, such as a route map, are saved in your workspace. They show up with the result.

everyone.title: A waiting permission card pings you
everyone.text: A permission card that waits for your answer plays a ping. A chat deleted while a card waits closes at once.

everyone.title: Messages kept, in order
everyone.text: Sends typed while a chat gets ready go out after its first message. Voice, phone and meeting turns wait for a busy chat.

everyone.title: Documents save and come back
everyone.text: A document saves at once and reaches a sleeping machine later. An idle document reloads when you return.

everyone.title: Claude Haiku 5.5 on both Claude engines
everyone.text: The fast tier joins Claude Code and Direct LLM with a 1M context, at a twentieth of Sonnet's price under 100K tokens. Chat titles run on it.

admins.title: Backup and restore by script
admins.text: One dated folder holds the database, the env file, the agents tree, the SSH keys and the connected accounts. The restore checks the backup first.

admins.title: The version and new releases
admins.text: Setup, OtoDock names the running version. A daily check tells you when a newer release exists, and an older server refuses a newer database.

admins.title: GitHub tokens fetched per command
admins.text: git and gh fetch the account's token per command, so no session or file holds it. A disconnected account stops on paired machines.

admins.title: The command floor on every engine
admins.text: The platform's refusals apply on every engine and in every mode. A /sys write asks instead over ssh and on a full-access machine.
